# Risk has changed. We can help you see it.


AI has fundamentally reshaped what risk looks like. We help you understand, detect, and manage that risk — across your entire environment, from IT to print to digital.


Risk has shifted in the past 12 months. What used to be a human threat landscape is now AI-driven, where automated agents act on behalf of users, often without those users fully understanding what they’re doing. AI has reshaped risk, and that opens the door to bring in the full[Xerox® IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) portfolio: AI assurance, network security, and endpoint detection that expands to our print offerings. All anchored to one idea: risk has changed, and we can help you understand it, see it, and manage it.


## Join our webinar series all through October


Five live webinars throughout Cybersecurity Awareness Month. Each one focuses on a different part of the security picture — from vulnerability management and AI governance to threat detection and Microsoft security operations.
